rv.q: It’s an entertaining, shape-shifting romp among cultural themes from the author of Cambodian Rock Band and Mother Russia . This time, Yee digs into her own history and comes up with rich cultural insights. Essentially the narrative spins around the author’s mostly fond bonds with her father Larry Yee, an ebullient Chinatown businessman.
